title: Graph Signal Generation via Graph-Aware Diffusion Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.27826v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many signals are defined on the nodes of a graph, such as traffic flow at road sensors or user purchases of related products. They are often partly observed, and learning their distribution enables imputing missing values and forecasting future ones. Diffusion models learn such distributions, but their forward noise is independent across nodes and does not depend on the graph. We introduce graph-aware diffusion (GAD), whose forward process is a heat diffusion on the graph driven by Gaussian noise. In the graph Fourier basis, the forward transition is a scalar Gaussian channel at each frequency. With a shared diffusion rate, high graph frequencies are attenuated faster than low ones. We propose Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling (MASS), which assigns each graph frequency its own diffusion rate and keeps all of them at the same SNR. translated_title: 基于图感知扩散模型的图信号生成
translated_abstract: 许多信号定义在图的节点上，例如道路传感器处的交通流量或用户对相关产品的购买。这些信号通常只被部分观测到，学习其分布可以实现对缺失值的插补以及对未来值的预测。扩散模型能够学习这类分布，但其前向噪声在各节点之间是相互独立的，并不依赖于图结构。我们提出图感知扩散（GAD），其前向过程是由高斯噪声驱动的图上热扩散。在图傅里叶基下，前向转移在每个频率上表现为一个标量高斯信道。在共享扩散速率的情况下，高图频率比低图频率衰减得更快。我们提出模式自适应信噪比调度（MASS），为每个图频率分配各自的扩散速率，并使所有频率保持相同的信噪比。对于图平稳信号，MASS 能够使最优线性去噪器在各频率上的归一化误差相等。
tldr: 提出图感知扩散模型（GAD），将前向过程建模为图上的热扩散，并设计模式自适应信噪比调度（MASS），为每个图频率分配独立扩散速率以保持相同信噪比，从而实现更好的图信号生成与分布学习。
en_tdlr: We propose graph-aware diffusion (GAD), whose forward process is heat diffusion on the graph, together with Mode-Adaptive SNR Scheduling (MASS) that assigns each graph frequency its own diffusion rate to maintain equal SNR, enabling better graph signal distribution learning and generation.
